construction.universal: KDF(ss_PQ || ss_T || ct_PQ || ct_T || ek_PQ || ek_T || label)
sources: NIST SP 800-227 section 4.6.2, Expression (15), and section 4.6.3

kdfs.sha3-256: SHA3-256 over the concatenated inputs followed by the label. Output is exactly 32 bytes.
kdfs.hkdf-sha512-label-as-info: HKDF-SHA512. salt absent (RFC 5869: 64 zero bytes), ikm is the concatenated inputs WITHOUT the label, info is the label, L is output_length.
kdfs.hkdf-sha512-label-in-ikm: HKDF-SHA512. salt absent (RFC 5869: 64 zero bytes), ikm is the concatenated inputs WITH the label appended, info is empty, L is output_length.

encoding: Every value in `inputs`, `intermediates` and `output` is hex. Inputs are concatenated with no length prefixes and no separators.

cases.name: universal/sha3-256/ml-kem-768+x25519-sizes
cases.note: Realistic ML-KEM-768 plus X25519 input sizes with distinct fill bytes per input.

cases.name: universal/hkdf-sha512-label-as-info/ml-kem-768+x25519-sizes
cases.note: Realistic ML-KEM-768 plus X25519 input sizes with distinct fill bytes per input.

cases.name: universal/hkdf-sha512-label-in-ikm/ml-kem-768+x25519-sizes
cases.note: Realistic ML-KEM-768 plus X25519 input sizes with distinct fill bytes per input.

cases.name: universal/sha3-256/ml-kem-1024+x448-sizes
cases.note: ML-KEM-1024 plus X448 sizes. The traditional half is 56 bytes, so an implementation that assumes 32 fails here.

cases.name: universal/hkdf-sha512-label-as-info/64-byte-output
cases.note: Two HKDF-Expand blocks, so a single block implementation fails here.

cases.name: universal/sha3-256/single-byte-inputs
cases.note: One byte per input, all distinct. A dropped or reordered input cannot survive this case.

cases.name: universal/sha3-256/all-zero-inputs
cases.note: Every KEM input is all zero bytes. Degenerate on purpose: an implementation that drops an input or short circuits on zeros still passes every other case and fails this one.

cases.name: universal/hkdf-sha512-label-as-info/all-zero-inputs
cases.note: The all zero case again under HKDF, where the absent salt is also all zero bytes: two different zero strings that must not be conflated.

cases.name: c2pri/sha3-256/ml-kem-768+x25519-sizes
cases.note: The C2PRI form over the same shared secrets as the universal case of the same name. The outputs differ: the two forms are not interchangeable.

cases.name: c2pri/hkdf-sha512-label-as-info/ml-kem-768+x25519-sizes
cases.note: The C2PRI form over the same shared secrets as the universal case of the same name. The outputs differ: the two forms are not interchangeable.

cases.name: c2pri/hkdf-sha512-label-in-ikm/ml-kem-768+x25519-sizes
cases.note: The C2PRI form over the same shared secrets as the universal case of the same name. The outputs differ: the two forms are not interchangeable.

cases.name: c2pri/sha3-256/xwing-draft-10-vector-1
cases.note: Interoperability. `output` is the shared secret published in Appendix C of draft-connolly-cfrg-xwing-kem-10, not a value this project computed. The four inputs are that vector's intermediates.

cases.name: c2pri/sha3-256/xwing-draft-10-vector-2
cases.note: Interoperability. `output` is the shared secret published in Appendix C of draft-connolly-cfrg-xwing-kem-10, not a value this project computed. The four inputs are that vector's intermediates.

cases.name: c2pri/sha3-256/xwing-draft-10-vector-3
cases.note: Interoperability. `output` is the shared secret published in Appendix C of draft-connolly-cfrg-xwing-kem-10, not a value this project computed. The four inputs are that vector's intermediates.

cases.name: universal/hkdf-sha512-label-as-info/interop-qk-password-manager-v1
cases.note: Interoperability. `output` is the value pinned by qk-password-manager's own conformance vectors, computed by an unrelated Rust implementation of this same construction.

negative_cases.name: reject/empty-ss-pq
negative_cases.note: A zero length shared secret is a dropped value, not a valid input.

negative_cases.name: reject/empty-label
negative_cases.note: An empty label provides no domain separation.

negative_cases.name: reject/sha3-256-wrong-output-length
negative_cases.note: SHA3-256 produces 32 bytes. Truncating or extending it silently would be worse than refusing.

negative_cases.name: reject/hkdf-domain-separation
negative_cases.note: Four one byte inputs give ikm_len = 4, and the label is 3 bytes, so ikm_len == info_len + 1. draft-irtf-cfrg-hybrid-kems-12 section 6.1.5 says instantiations MUST refuse this.
